meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 分析你仓库里所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR,每个条目各起一个后台任务单独处理,报告写成文件存到 /tmp/时间戳/ 目录。每条结论都要附 GitHub 永久链接作证据,且它只读不写——不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词时触发,它接管整个仓库开放 issue 与 PR 的排查分析。

say.note: 逐个分析开放 issue 并写成报告文件
逐个分析开放 PR 并写成报告文件
issue 和 PR 一起排队分析

howto.what_en: Analyzes every open issue and PR in your repo, one background task per item, writing reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Each claim needs a GitHub permalink as proof, and it is read-only: no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs" — it then takes over triage of the repo's open issues and PRs.

say_en.note: Analyzes each open issue into a report file
Analyzes each open PR into a report file
